real_objective: Reduce wall-clock time to permanent verified Opus-5.5-or-better capability ownership by harvesting only missing learned mechanisms from existing white-box donors.
governing_invariants: Opaque provider access is not ownership.
Capability credit requires a Brain-owned operative route independently verified >= Opus 5.5.
Current untouched wal-recovery-ordering qualification must not be contaminated by governance work.
material_premises: Current V6 law already allows generic extraction but does not define a first-class white-box donor route or promotion contract.
Open-weight/white-box systems can expose already-existing learned mechanisms that may be transferable as deltas, adapters, experts/modules, distilled residual behavior, or explicit algorithms.
A harvested artifact is not owned if it still requires the donor's hidden target capability at runtime.
Correlation or interpretability alone is insufficient; causal ablation/rescue, held-out verification, specificity, and donor deletion are required.
conclusion: Promote white-box capability harvesting as a governed acquisition route after deletion/reuse/substitution and before composition/configuration, with a strict capability-capsule contract and no capability credit from donor performance alone.
rejected_material_alternatives: Adopt a whole open model as Brain
Treat weights as automatically owned capability
Use SAE feature correlation as capability proof
Execute or inspect the untouched WAL task during governance update
uncertainties: Some learned mechanisms may be distributed and not practically separable.
Licenses may constrain derivative extraction or redistribution and must be checked per donor.
assumptions: At least some future capability gaps have legally usable white-box donors.
Existing Brain verification infrastructure can test donor-independent capsules.
non_goals: No claim that every capability is localizable.
No claim that parameter count alone measures progress.
No capability promotion in this governance change.
next_action: Merge only after trusted guard validates cross-surface consistency; then continue the current direct WAL qualification unless a fresh OBS route decision changes the frontier.
supersession_conditions: Causal harvesting is falsified across materially different capability classes.
A faster sufficient acquisition route dominates harvesting for a target.
Terminal ownership theory changes under explicit user authorization.
